definitions.explanation: Inflammation of the bronchial tubes (airways leading to the lungs), causing coughing, mucus production, and difficulty breathing.

examples.japanese: {気管支炎|きかんしえん}と{診断|しんだん}された。
{風邪|かぜ}をこじらせて{気管支炎|きかんしえん}になってしまった。
examples.english: My cold got worse and turned into bronchitis.

examples.japanese: {慢性|まんせい}{気管支炎|きかんしえん}の{患者|かんじゃ}は{冬場|ふゆば}に{症状|しょうじょう}が{悪化|あっか}しやすい。
examples.english: Patients with chronic bronchitis tend to have worsening symptoms in winter.

notes:
A compound of {気管支|きかんし} (bronchial tubes) and {炎|えん} (inflammation). The {炎|えん} suffix is used for many inflammatory conditions: {肺炎|はいえん} (pneumonia), {胃腸炎|いちょうえん} (gastroenteritis), {関節炎|かんせつえん} (arthritis), etc.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {急性|きゅうせい}{気管支炎|きかんしえん} — acute bronchitis
- {慢性|まんせい}{気管支炎|きかんしえん} — chronic bronchitis
- {気管支炎|きかんしえん}にかかる — to come down with bronchitis
- {気管支炎|きかんしえん}の{治療|ちりょう} — treatment for bronchitis

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {肺炎|はいえん} — pneumonia (more severe; infection of the lung tissue itself)
- {喘息|ぜんそく} — asthma (chronic condition with airway constriction, not the same as bronchitis)
- {風邪|かぜ} — common cold (milder; bronchitis can develop from an untreated cold)
